title: Doncaster economy timeline template
subject: Geography
unit: Spring 1: Earning a living and globalisation
source: Seeded from geography/y9 lesson 10 (Doncaster economy timeline template (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 10: The UK's changing employment; change in and around Doncaster (3.2, 3.3). To understand how UK employment has changed over time, using Doncaster as an example

questions.a: From coal mining and railway engineering to logistics, retail and services
questions.model: Past: coal mines and the railway works. Change: mines closed from the 1980s to 2015. Now: warehouses, logistics, shops and services.

questions.q: Give one effect of pit closures on a community.
questions.a: For example: unemployment, shops closing, people moving away

questions.q: Core: Make a timeline of Doncaster's economy with four stages and one sentence each.
questions.a: 1900s coal and railway works; 1923 and 1938 famous locomotives; 1980s to 2015 pit closures; 2000s onwards logistics and services
questions.model: Teacher shows the first stage: '1900s: Doncaster is ringed by coal mines and has a big railway works.'

questions.q: Extend: In the portal response box, explain the effects of deindustrialisation on Doncaster.
questions.a: Job losses and unemployment, knock-on effects on shops and services, then regeneration with new logistics jobs

questions.q: Stretch: Are new warehouse jobs as good as the old mining jobs? Explain.
questions.a: Reasoned view on pay, skills, security, safety and community

questions.q: Big question: what happens to a town when its main industry closes?
questions.a: Jobs are lost and the community suffers, until new industries and regeneration bring different jobs
